description1.title: Preparing a cup of coffee
text: Check if the water tank is filled and if there are coffee beans in the compartment.
Press the Power button and wait approximately 30 seconds until the machine completes heating and automatic cleaning.
Place a cup under the coffee dispenser.
Choose the desired beverage: espresso, Espresso Lungo, coffee, Iced Coffee (coffee with ice)
If desired, you can modify: coffee strength (button with coffee bean), coffee quantity (button with cup), temperature (button with thermometer)
Press the ▶⏸ (Start) button on the right side to begin coffee preparation.
Wait for the preparation to complete and enjoy your coffee.

description2.title: Preparing Milk Foam
text: Introduce the steam wand into a container with cold milk.
Gently swirl the container to create fine foam.
After use, clean the steam wand immediately.

description3.title: Preparing Hot Water
text: Place a kettle under the steam wand.
The machine will provide hot water for tea or other beverages.
